name: launchlist
description: Validate an idea and launch a product with LaunchList: test demand with a quick waitlist, write the launch page, find where to share it for your first signups, grow it with referrals, read what the numbers actually say, invite people in, email your waitlist, and wire it into code.

interface.shortDescription: Test an idea with a waitlist
interface.longDescription: LaunchList is pre-launch waitlist software for founders. Connect your workspace to test demand for an idea with a quick waitlist, write and publish your launch page, plan where to share it for your first signups, see how your launch is doing, look people up, invite people in, tag and segment your audience, get advice on referrals and rewards, and email your waitlist. It publishes pages and sends emails only with your approval.
defaultPrompt: Help me test demand for my idea with a waitlist
Where should I share my waitlist to get my first signups?
How is my waitlist doing this week?
